provider: ResearchGate figure page for a 2020 MDPI Sensors article (publication 340013233), figure 4: (a) building photo, (b) floor plan with test path A-D
capture_method: Direct image download returned HTTP 403, so these are screenshots of the figure rendered in the in-app browser. The plan crops were redrawn to a canvas at 0.94x and 2.43x of the 850x1089 source.

files.researchgate_sensors2020_fig4_full.jpg: whole figure: (a) photo from the NW at the entrance corner; (b) plan; corridor photos

used_for: SE wing is a right-angled wedge on the bar's south side, and its east side runs straight into the bar's pointed east end with no rectangular notch
The east end is a diagonal NE face that ends in a point at the south, with a stair/vestibule (east entrance) at the point
The west wing is a block turned along the diagonal and set against the bar's glazed west end
Photo (a): the red NW point's two arms are about the same width, and the west arm runs out over the west wing's glass top floor
uncertainty: The plan has no scale bar and the figure is low resolution. It was used only for topology and relative shape. Positions still come from the LiDAR/satellite trace.
